scope: Bounded selected-path source/config/provenance audit; no hardware contact or image modification; archive members read directly without tree extraction.

chain: docs/evidence/protected-sd-baseline-20261109.json binds physical first 256 MiB to protected SD image
docs/evidence/protected-state-bootstrap-20261109.json binds protected image and unchanged firmware prefix to corrected VGIC base
docs/evidence/vgic-runtime-bootstrap-20261108.json and authenticated retained base-bootstrap-manifest bind preserved prefix to EL2 boot0/package

firmware_provenance.chain_limit: Uses retained/committed preservation evidence; this audit does not reread hardware or reconstruct the current image.

disabled_routine_paths: ENV_IS_NOWHERE=y; all persistent ENV_IS_IN backends unset; env/nowhere.c registers init only, no storage save/load hook. CMD_SAVEENV unset.
BOOTCOUNT_LIMIT unset; include/bootcount.h makes bootcount_inc a no-op when neither SPL nor ordinary limit is enabled. No SPL_BOOTCOUNT_LIMIT assignment exists in retained config.
BOOTCMD_SKIP_MISC=y removes misc command consumption/clear-write path in board_helper.c. SUNXI_SWITCH_SYSTEM unset excludes env-save A/B-switch object.
No CONFIG_SUNXI_OTA_TURNNING assignment; board_common.c OTA boot0 update call excluded. SUNXI_AUTO_UPDATE, SUNXI_FDT_SAVE, SUNXI_RECOVERY_BOOT0_COPY0 disabled.
normal_script: Retained host boot.cmd hash matches current source; boot.scr retained hash f1ba10868782026d6fa4392b5e5f60db7953e8a340539f750ad710fb2b2032f1. U-Boot selects mmc0 then distro scan; boot files namespace has only reviewed boot.scr and payloads. Script loads payloads to RAM, changes RAM env/bootargs and FDT buffer, calls bootm or loops. No persistent write command. setenv/fdt resize do not themselves save environment or DTB to SD.
enabled_but_inert_selected_paths: SUNXI_BOOT_PARAM=y, but sunxi_bootparam_down immediately returns before download/write.
SUNXI_UPDATE_GPT=y, but normal-init sunxi_update_gpt call commented.
residual_limits: CMD_MMC, CMD_EXT4_WRITE, SUNXI_FLASH, SUNXI_BURN and secure-storage/keybox support remain compiled; firmware is not globally incapable of writing. Manual update/recovery commands are outside routine reviewed script.
Generic flash init invokes update_backup_boot0. MMC implementation skips in SUNXI_NORMAL_MODE but can mirror boot0 in another runtime mode; no fresh runtime mode proof collected here.

Keybox init can reencrypt/write stored keys when secure OS, key list and error conditions hold. No keybox_list assignment was found in pinned text source inputs, and missing list leaves count zero. This is not a universal statement about opaque secure firmware or all possible runtime conditions.
Opaque boot0, TF-A/monitor, SCP and other packed firmware behavior is not proved by U-Boot config/source. Linux counters omit pre-kernel I/O; equal hashes cannot detect same-content writes.
remaining_evidence: Preserve active 24-hour workload and UART capture through scheduled November 10 02:16 UTC outcome retention.

After workload outcome retention, perform original planned whole-card comparison after workload/shutdown and final matched cold/warm boot series, retaining exact SD CID, hashes and Linux write counters.

Review matching serial boot/shutdown records for storage/update/recovery modes and unexpected writes, including normal-mode backup-boot0 skip and keybox behavior where printed. Escalate observed contradictions; no new mandatory external instrument or replacement image gate is introduced.
conclusion: Documentation can record this bounded current-firmware source audit now. Complete zero-routine-SD-write hardware acceptance still needs planned fresh physical evidence and cannot be marked passed.

coordinator_supplied_serial_observation.interpretation: Reported ordinary work/storage selection supports current normal SD boot; it is not the separate sunxi_get_securemode result and does not alone close backup-boot0, keybox, opaque-stage or future-boot behavior.
coordinator_supplied_serial_observation.other_reported_observation: bootparam magic error line 2183; no keybox/reencrypt/secure-storage/misc-write text marker. Absence of markers is not proof of no writes.
